cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get to the bottom of these missing biscuits. Two gone at once suggests an organized operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ate them. Please don't turn it into an investigation about me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, no names. A quick admission like that suggests people have learned to protect the system. Just tell me what made you take them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was hungry. Lunch was late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll look at the timetable, not you. You can choose how we ask the others. If hunger is organizing the office, this is much bigger than a biscuit tin.

reason: Make A accommodate B anonymity while converting simple eating and late lunch into system-wide forces, with B survey wording choice sustaining cooperation.
